# Worlds

Kind: context · Defined in [`src/scene/world.h`](../../../src/scene/world.h) · Scene / prefab name: `null` · Described in `data/core.json`

The worlds of a scene in index order (dynamical's host context)

## Fields

| Field | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `list` | `std::vector<std::unique_ptr<World>>` | each with its registry, SystemSet, clock |

## Notes

Emplaced by Game::start when the scene has worlds; stepped by WorldStepper, drawn by WorldView; ScenarioRunner holds its own (not in a context).

## Systems that touch it

Read only by: AnimalAgentView, AnimalBotSteer, DesktopRoller, GaitView, ModelWatcher, SandboxWatch, SphereView, VRRoller, WalkerView, WorldView. Written by: Game, WorldStepper. Created by: Game. Destroyed by: —.

## Side effects of those systems

- **[AnimalAgentView](../systems/AnimalAgentView.md)**
  - Loads the animal library index (preinit) and the viewed species (first tick) from disk on the main thread; logs which.
  - With "log", opens the file once (truncated) and appends a CSV line every frame, flushed.
  - ImGui window "Animal".
  - Creates host entities (one skin per world with a built bot, 800 tiles with marks) that are never destroyed (no finish).
- **[AnimalBotSteer](../systems/AnimalBotSteer.md)**
  - Creates one proxy entity per world with a built animal, destroys them in finish.
  - Writes into other registries: the AnimalBot command of each world, read at the next world step.
- **[DesktopRoller](../systems/DesktopRoller.md)**: none beyond its components.
- **[GaitView](../systems/GaitView.md)**
  - ImGui window "Gait" (with "panel").
  - Pooled host marker entities, destroyed in finish.
- **[Game](../systems/service-Game.md)**
  - Reads and writes ./config.7.json; reads resources/graphics.json and the scene files.
  - Creates the Renderer (Vulkan, SDL window, OpenXR).
  - Creates the host thread pool (tf::Executor).
  - Logs unknown arguments, ignored values, the graphics level and scene errors.
- **[ModelWatcher](../systems/ModelWatcher.md)**
  - Reads the file system: lists <dir> (or the directories matching a '*' component) for <behavior>-<step>.onnx every `poll` seconds of wall clock; a new checkpoint is loaded once two polls see the same size and write time.
  - Creates ONNX Runtime sessions (PolicyRunner, or AgentPolicy through a process-wide cache keyed by path and write time).
  - Logs info on every load, a warning when a folder has no checkpoint, an error when a model is refused.
- **[SandboxWatch](../systems/SandboxWatch.md)**: none beyond its components.
- **[SphereView](../systems/SphereView.md)**
  - ImGui window "Sphere roller"; collapses "Dynamical", "Worlds" and "Frame time" on first use.
  - Five host entities for the markers, destroyed in finish.
- **[VRRoller](../systems/VRRoller.md)**: none beyond its components.
- **[WalkerView](../systems/WalkerView.md)**
  - ImGui window "Walker" (tick, decisions, target speed, speed, head height, reward, slope).
- **[WorldStepper](../systems/WorldStepper.md)**
  - Runs every world's fixed systems (physics, agents, ...) on the main thread, sequentially (no executor passed to Worlds::step).
  - Frame dt is clamped to 0.25 s; when more than h is left after 8 ticks the remaining time is dropped (no spiral).
  - ImGui window "Worlds" (world count, tick, h, Pause checkbox, Step button).
- **[WorldView](../systems/WorldView.md)**
  - Uploads generated capsule meshes to the GPU through ModelManager::add (Transfer), once per size.
  - Creates and destroys host entities as bodies appear and go; destroys all of them in finish.
